Raw 11964 vertices / 27707 tris with merge_vertices, components 11941+15+8; the two specks (15 and 8 vertices) were deleted. Rework 2026-10-21: the TRELLIS stalk under the disc was a lumpy 4 cm post, not a C-clamp, so it was cut off below z = -4 mm and the hole closed; a modelled C-clamp replaces it (back bar, lower jaw, screw, pad and knob, 116 tris, all weighted 1.0 to the base bone, reaching 11.2 cm below the table plane) plus 4 spring cylinders. Final 11162 vertices, 10 connected components (the TRELLIS body, 5 clamp parts and 4 springs, each overlapping the body), 0 floaters (a floater is a component whose bounding box touches no other), 26 open edges (small holes in the cap and joints, left from TRELLIS). rig.weights: proxy heat (ARMATURE_AUTO on a 4 mm voxel proxy) transferred by nearest proxy vertex; then smooth x3, limit 4, normalize
rig.look_at: head bone constraint DAMPED_TRACK to empty look_at_target, influence 0 in every pose action (FBX does not carry constraints; UE aims the head bone in its AnimBP)

finishing_note: Springs: modelled: 4 thin brushed-silver cylinders (8 sides, radius 3.5 mm), two on each arm segment (one each side), 112 tris in total, weighted 1.0 to the arm bone they run along. They are plain cylinders, not coils: a coil pitch of about 2 mm at lamp scale is under 1 px at the far edge (the first build judged this on a 1.63 m view), so a cylinder reads the same as the spring in concept A and costs 112 tris. The pale strip that was the smudge on the TRELLIS arm texture is gone (the arm is flat navy). Materials: one slot per region with flat values (arm navy, silver joints, springs and screw, dark shade, warm glow, amber cap, navy base and clamp), plus the same values baked flat into the three PNGs. The old lamp_body slot is replaced by six slots; lamp_shade_glow keeps its name.

framing.method: render_lamp.bpy fits every camera to the world bounding box of the evaluated (posed) mesh with a 6 % margin per side; then a transparent-film alpha pass of the lamp alone is rendered with the same camera and the check asserts that no lamp pixel touches the border and that the silhouette keeps at least 5 % of the image on every side
